items.title: Nordic PGDay 2027 - Call for Papers & Sponsors!
items.summary: We are pleased to announce that the Call for Papers for Nordic PGDay 2027 is now open. The conference will take place in Stockholm, Sweden on March 16, continuing the tradition of bringing together PostgreSQL users, developers, and enthusiasts from across the Nordic region and beyond. The Call for Papers will remain open until 8 January 2027, and all speakers will be informed about the selection results by 28 January 2027.For 2027 the program has been expanded to a one-and-a-half track community format, complemented by an additional half-track dedicated to our sponsors. This structure allows us to accommodate a greater number of high-quality talks. Speaking at Nordic PGDay is an excellent opportunity to present your work to a knowledgeable and engaged audience, contribute to the growth of the community, and connect with peers from across the region.We would also like to invite companies and organizations to consider sponsoring Nordic PGDay 2027. Sponsorship offers an opportunity to connect with the PostgreSQL community, increase visibility among users and developers, and support the continued success of community-driven PostgreSQL events. For more information please visit our sponsors page.Information about the CfP committee, including the members responsible for reviewing proposals, is available on the conference website.
